name: Tabletop Turbo
desc: An unaffiliated top-down racer across four miniature circuits: choose one of four balanced cars and race three AI rivals through desk, breakfast, garden, and pool courses. Drift, use chevron boosts, and dodge spills; the 3D scenery and sound are generated at runtime.
controls: ↑/W accelerate; ↓/S brake or reverse; ←/→ or A/D steer; Space handbrake/drift; P/Esc pause; R restart; M mute; Enter confirm/next.
creator: Jovan Veljanoski
